tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect local monitor state and section counts. Select a section for paginated details, following nextOffset. Long diagnostic fields are marked previews. Does not contact GitLab.

tools.name: start
tools.description: Start this project's monitor. It reads GitLab and publishes observations to followed channels.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Request that this project's monitor stop. Already in-flight operations may finish; check status.

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Configure observation of one exact MR in an existing channel. Requires a stopped monitor. Does not start polling or perform a review.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Configure repository discovery and one channel per matching MR. Requires a stopped monitor; does not start polling, assign reviews or write to GitLab.

tools.name: stop_watch
tools.description: Pause one discovery watch. Existing MR subscriptions remain unchanged.

tools.name: resume_watch
tools.description: Enable one discovery watch again. Does not start the monitor or resume archived source links.

tools.name: unfollow
tools.description: Stop following an exact subscription ID and cancel its undelivered observations. Does not close the MR or archive the channel.
